content: Busted official documentation states it supports Lua >= 5.1 and LuaJIT and provides describe/it style specs with expressive assertions. This matches Mudlet Lua 5.1 and boop current tests. For hardening, use Busted as the primary automated test surface, keep specs behavior-level with Mudlet globals stubbed only at boundaries, and do not introduce a second Lua test framework before 1.0.
